## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue when available.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. Include Unity version, platform, and resolution when relevant. State any checks you could not run.

## Assets, compatibility, and limits

Call out new or changed assets and their licenses, save migrations, package changes, and known limitations. Describe substantial AI assistance where applicable. Remove this section if none apply.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has one clear purpose and includes needed documentation.
- [ ] Added or moved Unity assets include their `.meta` files.
- [ ] New content has a documented origin and appropriate redistribution terms.
- [ ] The diff excludes credentials, private records, local saves, build output, and unrelated generated changes.
